args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west; error rate 18%). Mitigation: rolled back all three regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release known healthy in production. Rollback verified in all regions. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure not yet investigated.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigation**: Confirmed checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all three production regions — rollout verified successfully.

3. **Incident**: Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 health check failures and the rollback action, with the on-call engineer paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. Root cause analysis of the v2.3.1 failure remains open for the on-call to investigate.
